crossRefs.note: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall…
So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel move from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall all keep…

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: They said, “There must be an inheritance for those who are escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe not be blotted out from Israel.
translations.bsb: They added, “There must be heirs for the survivors of Benjamin, so that a tribe of Israel will not be wiped out.
translations.kjv: And they said, There must be an inheritance for them that be escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe be not destroyed out of Israel.
translations.asv: And they said, There must be an inheritance for them that are escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe be not blotted out from Israel.
